description: Search Magist’s open counsel directory for law firms by jurisdiction and practice area. Returns an editorial / firm-claimed directory to help a user identify licensed attorneys to consult. Inclusion is not endorsement; verify bar status and conflicts independently before engaging.

jurisdiction.description: Jurisdiction code, e.g. "us", "us-ca", "eu", "uk". A country/region name ("Australia", "United States") is also accepted and resolved to its code; the code actually searched comes back as `resolvedJurisdiction`. A code matches itself and its sub-jurisdictions, never the reverse — a firm listed only for "us" is not returned for "us-mt".

language.description: Optional preferred language. Accepted for forward-compatibility; not yet a filter at launch.

name: find_counsel
title: Find licensed counsel
